insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Current UIN of Optima Secure (V6 2024-25). 30-day free look per IRDAI 2024 master circular. Aggregate Deductible optional. Includes overseas treatment definition (Medical Practitioner outside India).

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent — no category restriction. Road ambulance up to Sum Insured.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes home treatment (Home Health Care), dental/plastic due to injury, day care, organ donor expenses.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in registered AYUSH Hospital.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance up to SI; Emergency Air Ambulance optional cover.

restoration_benefit.notes: Automatic Restore Benefit refills 100% SI on first claim.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Optional worldwide cover available; defines overseas Medical Practitioner.

notable_exclusions_summary: Flagship indemnity plan with no room-rent cap, no co-pay, 2x SI via Plus + Secure benefits, automatic restore, 60/180 pre/post-hospitalisation.
available_riders: Plus Benefit (50% SI added Y2, +50% Y3)
